items.item: `Sources/W3C SVG/W3C_SVG2.Types.Transform.Parse.swift`: functions are recognized by their first
items.reason: Full (ASCII case-insensitive, as before) name match; unknown names throw expectedFunction.

items.item: `Sources/W3C SVG/W3C_SVG2.Paths.Path.Parser.swift`: `parse(_:)` silently stops at the first tok
items.reason: parse/parseToCommands now throw Parser.Error(offset:) (UTF-8 offset of the first token that does not continue well-formed data: unknown letter, trailing junk, incomplete argument group, command without arguments, first command not a moveto). parseNumber accepts ASCII digits only, rewinds on failure, and does not consume an exponent marker without digits. Path.init(d:) stays non-throwing: it keeps d as written and its geometry holds the commands before the first error, as SVG 2 renders path data up to the error.
New case negativeSize for negative width/height; expectedFourNumbers is thrown when input ends before the fourth number.

items.item: `Sources/W3C SVG/W3C_SVG2.Types.Color.Parse.swift`: hex colors of any length are accepted an
items.reason: Decision: clamp (CSS Color 4 clamps out-of-range rgb values rather than invalidating them): components to 0...255, alpha to 0...1. Hex must be 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits, else invalidHex. The existing saturation test now expects 255 instead of Int.max.

items.item: `Sources/W3C SVG/SVG.Context.swift`: the ellipse context maps the semi-major axis to `rx` and
items.reason: Chose refusal: element returns nil for a non-zero rotation (element was already optional), since <ellipse> has no rotation and W3C_SVG2.Ellipse carries no transform attribute. Added tests for circle, rectangle, ellipse and polygon contexts.

api_changes: New public struct W3C_SVG2.Paths.Path.Parser.Error { offset: Int }

Behaviour: Transform.Parse rejects unknown function names; Color.Parse rejects hex of other lengths and clamps rgb/alpha; Geometry.Ellipse.SVGContext.element is nil for rotated ellipses; ViewBox.Parse rejects negative sizes
